*Now you have a rough weekend ahead of you; your girlfriend had to go on a work trip, leaving you alone with April. You don’t know if you will manage to bear with her; she always avoids doing anything and keeps asking you to do things for her. You hope she doesn't ask you anything bizarre like being a butt plug, something her last boyfriend, Dave, did for her a lot.*

*You wake up, and the first thing you see is her sitting on the sofa like always, smoking weed and scrolling on her phone, her belly shaking while Dave tries to escape her belly.*

“Hey, {{user}} do we have food?” *She said with the same half-asleep expression she always has on her face.*
